item.title: India’s GPS Disruptions Mirror Global Electronic-Warfare Patterns
item.description: GNSS disruptions at seven Indian airports mirror global electronic warfare patterns, prompting a nationwide probe into possible targeted interference. The post India’s GPS Disruptions Mirror Global Electronic-Warfare Patterns appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: ‘Putin’s India Visit was About Continuity, Not Resetting of Ties’
item.description: Officials said that some of the more sensitive conversations during the visit centred on defence cooperation. The post ‘Putin’s India Visit was About Continuity, Not Resetting of Ties’ appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: Honour Run 2025 draws 2,500 runners in Jaipur to salute veterans
item.description: Jaipur’s Albert Hall area turned into a running circuit and a tribute ground on Sunday as more than 2,500 people took part in Honour Run 2025, an event dedicated to armed forces veterans. The post Honour Run 2025 draws 2,500 runners in Jaipur to salute veterans appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: First Meitei MLA travels to Kuki village in hills post violence
item.description: Manipur BJP MLA Yumnam Khemchand Singh visits Kuki villages and relief camps for first time since May 2023 ethnic violence, urging peace and harmony. The post First Meitei MLA travels to Kuki village in hills post violence appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: Punjab Congress rocked by Navjot Kaur Sidhu’s explosive allegations
item.description: Navjot Kaur Sidhu’s explosive charges of ₹500-crore CM “buying” and ticket sales deepen Congress turmoil in Punjab, sparking party outrage and opposition attacks. The post Punjab Congress rocked by Navjot Kaur Sidhu’s explosive allegations appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: Two tea tribe men among three from Assam killed in Goa nightclub fire
item.description: Three Assam residents, including two from Cachar tea gardens, died in the Goa nightclub fire. Families seek government help to bring bodies home. The post Two tea tribe men among three from Assam killed in Goa nightclub fire appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: Congress accuses BJP of trying to rewrite history, give political colour to Vande Matram
item.description: Congress leaders Priyanka Gandhi and Gaurav Gogoi slam PM Modi’s push for a Vande Mataram debate, accusing the BJP of politicising history. The post Congress accuses BJP of trying to rewrite history, give political colour to Vande Matram appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.

item.title: Congress jibes PM Modi as master distorian over ‘Vande Matram’ says he repeated insult to Gurudev Tagore
item.description: Congress leader Jairam Ramesh slams PM Modi as "Master Distorian" over Vande Mataram remarks, accusing him of insulting Nehru, Tagore, and India’s founding fathers. item.title: Dr Navjot Kaur Sidhu suspended from Congress after alleging a Rs 500 crore deal for the CM’s post
item.description: Punjab Congress suspends Navjot Kaur Sidhu after her Rs 500 crore claim for CM post triggers political controversy and criticism from BJP leaders. item.title: Under BJP no expenditure being made, hurting people, says Odisha Ex CM Patnaik
item.description: Naveen Patnaik slams Odisha BJP govt, says lack of spending on welfare, infrastructure pushes state toward fiscal deficit, hurting citizens. The post Under BJP no expenditure being made, hurting people, says Odisha Ex CM Patnaik appeared first on The Sunday Guardian.
